title: Passarola — Scarlatti K. 87
summary: An audiovisual study of Domenico Scarlatti’s Piano Sonata in B minor, K. 87. Rui Gato composed the study from research for Passarola — Variations on the Past and the Future K.87, the live work created with Pedro Emanuel Pereira and Vítor Joaquim.

descriptions.content: Um estudo audiovisual sobre a Sonata para Piano em Si menor K. 87, de Domenico Scarlatti. Rui Gato compôs este estudo a partir da investigação para Passarola — Variations on the Past and the Future K.87, a obra ao vivo criada com Pedro Emanuel Pereira e Vítor Joaquim.

An audiovisual study of Domenico Scarlatti’s Piano Sonata in B minor, K. 87. Rui Gato composed the study from research for Passarola — Variations on the Past and the Future K.87, the live work created with Pedro Emanuel Pereira and Vítor Joaquim.
